blocks.en: Maximum Principles
blocks.zh: 极值原理
blocks.label: chap:maximum-principles

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The maximum principle asserts that solutions of certain scalar elliptic equations of second order cannot have a maximum (or a minimum) in the interior of the domain where they are defined. The basic idea is quite simple. Consider, for simplicity, Laplace\textquotesingle s equation $\Delta u=0$. If $u$ has a maximum at a point $\bm{x}$ and the second derivatives of $u$ do not all vanish at $\bm{x}$, then $\Delta u$ is negative at $\bm{x}$, in contradiction to the equation. The only case left to be ruled out is that of degenerate maxima where all second derivatives vanish. This is accomplished by an approximation argument which removes the degeneracy.
blocks.zh: 最大值原理断言, 某些二阶标量椭圆方程的解不能在其定义区域内部具有最大值 (或最小值). 基本思想很简单. 为简单起见, 考虑 Laplace 方程 $\Delta u=0$. 若 $u$ 在点 $\bm{x}$ 处有最大值, 且 $u$ 的二阶导数在 $\bm{x}$ 处不全为零, 则 $\Delta u$ 在 $\bm{x}$ 处为负, 与方程矛盾. 剩下唯一需要排除的情形是所有二阶导数均为零的退化最大值. 通过消除退化性的逼近论证, 即可完成这一步.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The maximum principle can be used to show that solutions of certain equations must be non-negative. This is important for quantities which have a physical interpretation as densities, concentrations, probabilities, etc. The maximum principle also leads to easy uniqueness results. In later chapters we shall see that in certain problems uniqueness also implies existence. The maximum principle itself can also be used to construct existence proofs. In the next section, we shall give Perron\textquotesingle s existence proof for Dirichlet\textquotesingle s problem. A very recent application of the maximum principle, too complicated to be discussed here, concerns "viscosity solutions" for Hamilton-Jacobi equations. In the third section of this chapter, we shall discuss a result of Gidas, Ni and Nirenberg~\cite{GNN}, which asserts that positive solutions to certain elliptic boundary-value problems must be radially symmetric. The final section of the chapter is concerned with the extension of the maximum principle to parabolic equations.
blocks.zh: 最大值原理可用于证明某些方程的解必为非负. 对具有密度, 浓度, 概率等物理解释的量, 这一点很重要. 最大值原理也容易导出唯一性结果. 在后面的章节中将看到, 对某些问题, 唯一性也蕴含存在性. 最大值原理本身还可用于构造存在性证明. 下一节将给出 Perron 对 Dirichlet 问题的存在性证明. 最大值原理的一个很新的应用涉及 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程的"黏性解", 但过于复杂, 这里不作讨论. 本章第三节将讨论 Gidas, Ni 和 Nirenberg 的一个结果~\cite{GNN}, 它断言某些椭圆边值问题的正解必具有径向对称性. 本章最后一节讨论将最大值原理推广到抛物型方程.

blocks.en: The Weak Maximum Principle

blocks.label: subsec:weak-maximum-principle

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The following assumptions are made throughout and will therefore not be stated with each theorem. $\Omega$ is a domain in $\mathbb{R}^n$. The coefficients $a_{ij}$, $b_i$ and $c$ are continuous on $\overline\Omega$, and $u$ is in $C^2(\Omega)\cap C(\overline\Omega)$. The matrix $a_{ij}$ is symmetric and strictly positive definite at every point $\bm{x}\in\overline\Omega$, i.e., $L$ is elliptic.
blocks.zh: 以下假设始终成立, 因而不在每个定理中重复陈述. $\Omega$ 是 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 中的区域. 系数 $a_{ij}$, $b_i$ 和 $c$ 在 $\overline\Omega$ 上连续, 且 $u$ 属于 $C^2(\Omega)\cap C(\overline\Omega)$. 矩阵 $a_{ij}$ 对称, 并在每个点 $\bm{x}\in\overline\Omega$ 处严格正定, 即 $L$ 为椭圆型算子.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The weak maximum principle is expressed by the following theorem.
blocks.zh: 以下定理表述弱最大值原理.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Assume that $Lu\geq0$ (or, respectively, $Lu\leq0$) in a bounded domain $\Omega$ and that $c(\bm{x})=0$ in $\Omega$. Then the maximum (or, respectively, the minimum) of $u$ is achieved on $\partial\Omega$.
blocks.zh: 假设在有界区域 $\Omega$ 内 $Lu\geq0$ (或相应地, $Lu\leq0$), 且在 $\Omega$ 内 $c(\bm{x})=0$. 那么 $u$ 的最大值 (或相应地, 最小值) 在 $\partial\Omega$ 上达到.
blocks.label: thm:weak-maximum-principle

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: For later use in connection with parabolic equations, we remark that the proof of Theorem~\ref{thm:weak-maximum-principle} still works if the matrix $a_{ij}$ is only positive semidefinite, as long as there is at least one vector $\bm{\xi}$ independent of $\bm{x}\in\overline\Omega$ such that $\xi_i a_{ij}\xi_j>0$.
blocks.zh: 为便于以后用于抛物型方程, 指出即使矩阵 $a_{ij}$ 仅半正定, 只要至少存在一个不依赖于 $\bm{x}\in\overline\Omega$ 的向量 $\bm{\xi}$, 使 $\xi_i a_{ij}\xi_j>0$, Theorem~\ref{thm:weak-maximum-principle} 的证明仍然成立.
blocks.label: rem:weak-maximum-semidefinite

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We have the following corollary of Theorem~\ref{thm:weak-maximum-principle}.
blocks.zh: 由 Theorem~\ref{thm:weak-maximum-principle} 有以下推论.

blocks.en: The following corollary is typically used in applications. It yields a uniqueness result as well as a comparison principle.
blocks.zh: 以下推论常用于应用中. 它既给出唯一性结果, 也给出比较原理.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $\Omega$ be bounded and $c\leq0$. If $Lu=Lv$ in $\Omega$ and $u=v$ on $\partial\Omega$, then $u=v$ in $\Omega$. If $Lu\leq Lv$ in $\Omega$ and $u\geq v$ on $\partial\Omega$, then $u\geq v$ in $\Omega$.
blocks.zh: 设 $\Omega$ 有界且 $c\leq0$. 若在 $\Omega$ 内 $Lu=Lv$, 且在 $\partial\Omega$ 上 $u=v$, 则在 $\Omega$ 内 $u=v$. 若在 $\Omega$ 内 $Lu\leq Lv$, 且在 $\partial\Omega$ 上 $u\geq v$, 则在 $\Omega$ 内 $u\geq v$.
blocks.label: cor:elliptic-comparison

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We draw the reader\textquotesingle s attention to the particular case $v=0$. The reader should also note the relationship between this result and the oscillation and comparison theorems of Sturm-Liouville theory in ODEs (cf.~\cite{In}).
blocks.zh: 提请读者注意特殊情形 $v=0$. 读者还应注意这一结果与常微分方程中 Sturm-Liouville 理论的振荡定理和比较定理之间的关系 (参见~\cite{In}).
blocks.label: rem:elliptic-comparison-sturm-liouville

blocks.en: We conclude this subsection with a definition.
blocks.zh: 以一个定义结束本小节.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Assume that $c\leq0$. If $Lu\geq0$ (or, resp., $Lu\leq0$), then $u$ is called a \textbf{subsolution} (\textbf{supersolution}) of the equation $Lu=0$. Subsolutions of $\Delta u=0$ are called \textbf{subharmonic}, and supersolutions are called \textbf{superharmonic}.
blocks.zh: 假设 $c\leq0$. 若 $Lu\geq0$ (或相应地, $Lu\leq0$), 则称 $u$ 为方程 $Lu=0$ 的\textbf{下解} (\textbf{上解}). 方程 $\Delta u=0$ 的下解称为\textbf{次调和的}, 上解称为\textbf{超调和的}.
blocks.label: def:elliptic-subsolution

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The terminology is motivated by Corollary~\ref{cor:elliptic-comparison}. A subsolution is less than or equal to a solution with the same values on the boundary; a supersolution is greater than or equal to a solution.
blocks.zh: 这一术语来自 Corollary~\ref{cor:elliptic-comparison}. 下解小于或等于具有相同边界值的解; 上解大于或等于解.
